journey.title: Triage the next finding
journey.purpose: The primary loop: a member arrives with no prior context, gets one ranked answer to 'what should I do next?', and can audit that answer back to the evidence and the setpoint that produced it — including deciding whether the problem is the platform or the instrument.

steps.intent: Read the top-ranked finding, and read the setpoint confidence and open-loop count beside it so the ranking is understood as partial rather than complete.
Check the source-availability region before trusting the ranking. If a source is unreadable, the absence of findings from it is not evidence of health.

Open the finding's reading and decide the question that determines everything downstream: is this a plant fault or an instrument fault? A non-VALID trust verdict routes to the instrument, never to plant-side work.
Read the target's history, re-graded against the current deadband, to distinguish a transient excursion from a sustained one.
Audit the deadband and actuator the finding was judged against, confirming the target is the right one to act on and that its honesty flag supports the claim.

claims.statement: The journey begins at the board and never requires the member to know which underlying scenario holds the answer.
claims.rationale: Invariant 1 of the instrument contract: a member starts at the board, not at the tools. Members read different rows of one surface, never different surfaces.

claims.statement: Every ranked finding can be traced from the board to its reading, its trust verdict, and the target and deadband it was judged against.
claims.rationale: A headline that cannot be audited to evidence is inferred rather than measured, and the board's whole claim is that it measures.

claims.statement: The journey surfaces the trust verdict before it surfaces any suggested action, so instrument fault is separated from plant fault before work is routed.
claims.rationale: Operating-model rule 5 — discriminate sensor fault from plant fault before routing plant-side work. Getting this backwards spends real effort on an imaginary problem.

claims.statement: No step in this journey offers a control that would restart, shelve, remediate, or otherwise change the state of a supervised element.
claims.rationale: Supervise, don't operate. The journey ends at a decision the member makes elsewhere; the instrument carries no authority to act.
